create_quataffine_from_quaternion_and_tr: create a QuatAffine object from a unit quaternion and translation vector for coordinate frame representation
convert_quaternion_to_rotation_matrix: convert a normalized quaternion tensor to a 3x3 rotation matrix using quat_to_rot
convert_rotation_matrix_to_quaternion: convert a rotation matrix to a quaternion tensor using rot_to_quat with eigendecomposition
apply_affine_transform_to_point: apply a QuatAffine transformation to rotate and translate a 3D point using apply_to_point
canonicalize_protein_backbone_atoms: compute canonical translation and rotation matrices from N, CA, C atom coordinates using make_canonical_transform
